description:
`dev/bench_results/` is an operational receipt store read by CI with hard-coded prefixes. Its receipt directories stay; its loose narrative Markdown reports move to their owners or the legacy mirror.

## Background

CI consumers and receipt structure are in `dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/investigation.md` §3.1, §3.10 and §6.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No loose narrative Markdown file remains at the top level of `dev/bench_results/`; receipt directories and files read by scripts or tests are unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: Reports owned by terminal epics live in those epics' archive directories; reports owned by open epics live under their epic's `dev/active/` directory and are linked; unowned reports live in the legacy mirror.
- [hard] REQ-03: Citations of moved reports are repointed, a link scan of the touched files reports no unresolved local link, and the receipt checks in the Rust CI gate pass.
- [hard] REQ-04: The manifest records each row as complete.
title: Relocate loose narrative reports out of dev/bench_results
